page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; two-column-less continuous text in the centre; small marginal notes in the left margin (faint, partly illegible) and right margin (small italic notes beside lines). Bottom: no catchword or signature visible.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~12 letters] ditione, ad invadendas Cuntrani terras millis Brunechtildis, Sigeberti vidua, Rothomagum, legatae, amore irretitus, eam in uxorem duxit; ideo à parte in cuiusdam malas miseras mox plus receptusque, illustrissimae Hauerice interfectus est. Regnum itaque penes Chilpericum remansit.

In SCOTIA excepit Congallus [?] Aenaei [?] & hunc* Aidanus Goranī Filius. De [illegible, ~6 letters] occurrit, fuit etiam qui, eo omisso, Aidanum Congallo subiiciunt. Ifte regia a Columbano, maximè tum auctoritatis viro, insignia accepit, latrones in Galloviaia, ducibus ipsorum suppli-cia affectis, compescuit; & bellum cum Pictis quod leditiosos, qui regios ministros, eos in jus vocantes pulsaffent, ex fœdere tradere nollent, gerit; quod tamen brevi Columbani auxilio hostes extinctum est.

Ex Dolis floruère Gildas Anglus, qui sui tempori historiam scripsit Venantius Fortunatus, Duplabilis dictus, qui gesta Sanctorum cum prosa tùm carmine edidit: Bandanonia, Rade-gundis alumna, quæ librum de ea reliquit. Tum etiam lupi Burdegalam ingressi, † neminem tuentes, canes devoraverunt.
main_text.head: SACRA.
main_text.p: ROMANÆ Ecclesiæ in hujus, quod hycu-nimus, temporis initius adhuc præfuit Johannes, quem excepere † Benedictus & † Pelagius. Eo adhuc vivente, Johannes Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus de Trinitate conjubstantiali sententiam habuit.

page.notes: Left and right margin notes are very faint and largely illegible; the right-margin marginalia (e.g. "Photius in Bibliotheca", "Sigeberti in Chronico", "Pagi" style references) are only partly legible. Several words in the body are damaged by show-through and staining; the [?] marks indicate doubtful readings. Marginal reference marks were not reliably located, so no note elements were built.
